name: Stochastic cross
idea: A signal when the stochastic K line crosses its D line coming out of the oversold zone (bullish) or the overbought zone (bearish); optionally only with the trend average on a higher timeframe.

params.label: Stochastic period
params.help: Bars the stochastic looks back over.

params.label: K smoothing
params.help: Bars that smooth the K line.

params.label: D line
params.help: Bars in the average of the K line that makes the D line.

params.label: Oversold level
params.help: A bullish cross counts when the K line was below this level on the bar before.

params.label: Overbought level
params.help: A bearish cross counts when the K line was above this level on the bar before.

params.label: Trend filter
params.help: Only signal when the close on the higher timeframe is on the same side of its trend average.

params.label: Trend average type
params.help: How the trend average is calculated.

params.label: Trend timeframe
params.help: The higher timeframe the trend filter reads (closed bars only).

params.label: Swing size
params.help: Which swings count: 0 is the smallest, 3 the largest. Larger swings need more history.

constraints.message: The trend timeframe must be higher than the signal timeframe.
